title: Cloud Sky Sect
summary: In the ancient cave Wang Lin learns that escaping the Ji Realm means giving up everything it built, so he instead uses a divine technique to make a clone that will form a Nascent Soul and later merge with his body, even though the clone lives only thirty years. The clone, at level 3 Qi Condensation, travels to the Country of Chu, a rank 3 cultivation country, for the once-every-thirty-years entrance test of the Cloud Sky Sect, alongside Cheng Fei of the Sword Qi Sect and his sister Cheng Ling. In the test pillars he draws a water-attribute pill, and Zhou Lin, a ninth-generation disciple, takes him as his first apprentice. Sun Zhenwei takes Cheng Ling as his disciple, and Zhou Lin turns out to be the only student of an Elder Li. Zhou Lin gives Wang Lin a pill furnace and his alchemy notes before going into seclusion, telling him to ask his grandmaster, who is gentle, for help.
events: Wang Lin finds that only giving up his Ji Realm cultivation would free him
He makes a clone to form a Nascent Soul instead
The clone enters the Cloud Sky Sect test in the Country of Chu with Cheng Fei and Cheng Ling
The clone draws a water-attribute pill from the test pillar
Zhou Lin takes Wang Lin as his apprentice; Sun Zhenwei takes Cheng Ling
Zhou Lin gives Wang Lin a furnace and notes and goes into seclusion
cultivation: Wang Lin's clone: level 3 Qi Condensation. Cheng Fei: late Foundation Establishment. Cheng Ling: early Foundation Establishment. Zhou Lin: Core Formation. Song Qing, Inner Sect master: mid Nascent Soul. Sun Zhenwei: late Core Formation.
